title: A land or pipeline ops row written by a probe run in a temporary clone reaches no real spool
goal: an ops row written by a probe whose working directory is not a checkout of the clone that owns the spool is not appended to that clone's spool, unless the caller names its own query-log home

run:
import os,shutil,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P
t1=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());t2=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
shutil.copytree("_tools",t1/"_tools",ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__","test_*"))
for d in (t1,t2):s.run(["git","-C",str(d),"init","-q"],check=True)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k not in ("PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST","CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA","CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT","CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR")}
code="import sys;sys.path.insert(0,%r);import bl_land;bl_land.ops_write(event='land.step',item='ST-ggggggg2',step='probe',exit=1,ms=5)"%str(t1/"_tools")
p=s.run([sys.executable,"-c",code],cwd=t2,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
rows=list((t1/"_cache").rglob("*.jsonl"))
print(p.returncode,len(rows),"spool row(s) written by a probe in another working directory")
sys.exit(1 if rows else 0)

clauses.clause: an ops row written by a probe whose working directory is not a checkout of the clone that owns the spool is not appended to that clone's spool, unless the caller names its own query-log home

notes: From the 2026-10-24 telemetry and query-log analysis: ops rows of 10-17 to 24 for item ids that exist in no backlog history of this repository: 43 land.end rows (27 with exit 1) and 127 land.step rows over 25 ids (9 failures), e.g. ST-ggggggg2; four land.step rows are named python3-private-var-folders-nr-3tgqljkx7 (the step label is a temp path, exit 1), written by probes whose clone is under the system temp directory. So 27 of the week's 143 failed land.end rows (19%) are fixture landings; a ci.pipeline row of 2026-10-24T00:03Z has state red and sha aaaaaaaaaaaa (not a commit), which the red-pipeline intake reads and could turn into a filed bug. ql_deliver.ops_row and record_pipeline skip rows only when PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST is set (ql_deliver.py:287-325) and bl_land.ops_write (bl_land.py:733) has no other guard, so a probe script run outside pytest writes to the spool of the clone whose tools it imports (the repro copies the tools to a temporary 'real clone' and runs the probe from another directory; nothing real is written). Honest failure figures are the gain. Partly covered by ST-6vyzk4oi (tells workers to set CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT in sample runs: docs only, no code guard). Medium confidence: the guard must not stop a landing run from a linked worktree of the owning clone or the plugin copy (CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA set). Also wanted: land.step labels are built from the program's name, never from an absolute path.
